answer: This gate blocks fake identities with a two-domain proof bundle: weight requires two proofs of real work. One is an on-chain task receipt, the other a signed receipt from another client; both bind to one key, and reuse is rejected. Reusing receipts across a spiral of clones fails, since one receipt cannot vouch for two keys. So the k-th fake needs a k-th new pair, each proof growing like a vine from its client: 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 credits at 20 per proof, while an honest agent pays once. Domain rental fails: a rented proof stays tied to its owner's key, so honest agents keep a haven.
